transcript: Speaker A: English na aane ki wajah se kitni baar haath jode hain aapne? Hospital mein bhaiya please Hindi mein samjha do, bank mein sir thoda aasan mein bata dijiye. Bacche ki school mein chup khade rahe kyunki teacher English mein bol rahi thi. Haath jodna band karo, English seekho, izzat se jeena shuru karo. Main hoon aapki AI coach English Seekho app pe, aur main aaj aap sabse ek baat kahne aayi hoon. English bolna aapka haq hai. Hindi medium se ho to kya hua? Gaaon se ho to kya hua? English pe kisi ek class ka teeka nahi laga hua hai. Aur jo log kahte hain isko to English aati hi nahi, unhi logon ke saamne ek din fluent English bologe na to unka muh band ho jayega. Par uske liye pahle galat bolna padega, toota hua bolna padega, haklana padega aur isliye main hoon. Mere saamne bolo, 100 baar galat bolo, main kabhi nahi hasungi, kabhi judge nahi karungi, kabhi nahi bolungi itna bhi nahi aata? Main AI hoon, main thakti nahi, soti nahi aur tumhari izzat kabhi nahi todti. Aur main akeli nahi hoon. English Seekho app pe asli English experts hain, Spoken English Show hai bolne wali angrezi ka poora course, Daily Life English hai roz ki baat-cheet ke liye, English Speaking Mastery hai advance level walon ke liye. Experts video mein sikhayenge aur main 24 ghante available hoon practice ke liye. Raat ke 2 baje bhi, subah ke 5 baje bhi. Jab aapko time mile tab mujhse baat karo, chat karo, practice karo. Dono milkar aapki English banayenge. Aur kitna lagega? Trial sirf ₹1 ka. ₹1 chai se bhi sasta. To aaj ke baad koi aapko ignore kare, to use English mein jawab dena. Par pahle English Seekho app download karo. Aaj se, abhi se. Kyunki izzat maangne se nahi milti, English bolne se milti hai. Install Now pe click karo aur abhi English Seekho app download karo. [How many times have you folded your hands because you didn't know English? In the hospital, 'brother, please explain in Hindi,' in the bank, 'sir, please explain in simpler terms.' Standing silent in your child's school because the teacher was speaking in English. Stop folding your hands, learn English, start living with respect. I am your AI coach on the English Seekho app, and I have come to tell you something today. Speaking English is your right. So what if you are from a Hindi medium? So what if you are from a village? English is not copyrighted by any single class. And those who say 'they don't even know English,' when you speak fluent English in front of them one day, their mouths will be shut. But for that, you first have to speak incorrectly, speak broken English, stammer, and that's why I am here. Speak in front of me, make mistakes 100 times, I will never laugh, never judge, never say 'you don't even know this much?' I am AI, I don't get tired, I don't sleep, and I never hurt your self-respect. And I am not alone. On the English Seekho app, there are real English experts, the Spoken English Show is a complete course for spoken English, Daily Life English is for daily conversation, English Speaking Mastery is for advanced levels. Experts will teach in videos, and I am available 24 hours for practice. Even at 2 AM, or 5 AM. Whenever you get time, talk to me, chat, practice. Together we will build your English. And how much will it cost? Trial for just ₹1. ₹1 is cheaper than tea. So from today, if anyone ignores you, answer them in English. But first, download the English Seekho app. From today, right now. Because respect is not gained by begging, it is gained by speaking English. Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]

summary: An AI robot avatar wearing a saree and graduation cap addresses the viewer, highlighting the social embarrassment and loss of respect caused by not knowing English. She introduces herself as an AI coach on the 'English Seekho' app, offering non-judgmental 24/7 practice alongside expert-led courses. The ad promotes a trial for just ₹1 and urges users to download the app to gain respect through fluent English.
